text: The Brain-Rot Think Tank is staffed. Somewhere, a PhD just stopped thinking, professionally.
Compounding returns. The kind the Illumisnotty hoarded for themselves. Until now.
The Crypto-Bro Compound is funded. WAGMI, probably, for someone.
The Loose Change Collective is live. A hundred million pockets, a fraction of a cent lighter, and nobody's the wiser.
Idle time isn't wasted anymore. It's working. Against them.
Every piece of infrastructure is a weapon the Illumisnotty never saw coming.
Passive income. Aggressive intent. The Illumisnotty hate this one trick.
Three more guys, four more hours, zero more facts. The Podcaster Soundboard hums.
The Great Reversal is live. Every dollar they stole starts finding its way back, and they still don't know how to stop it.
The Literal Library. Where reading happens to people, not for them.
The Snott Market Exchange is trading. Untraceable, untaxed, and technically an act of war.
Converting cash to Restoration Points. Very responsible. Very sad.
That's the yield. The rest of their potential is already spent -- mostly on nothing.
Floor reached. Whatever's left in their heads tonight isn't for you -- not until they've slept on it.
You've taken today's ceiling. What remains in their heads isn't stupidity anymore, it's just static.
Diminishing returns, effective immediately. Give them a night to marinate; they'll be worth harvesting again by morning.
Surplus depleted. There is nothing left down there worth harvesting today.
The well runs dry precisely on schedule. Reassuring, in its way.
Cash money detected. You have entered the second economy. It smells like mildew and compromise.
Underground cash flow detected. Unofficial. Untraceable. The Illumisnotty are filing a complaint with no one.
World Restoration initiated. The Illumisnotty have entered emergency committee deliberation. It will take decades.
Oh good, you're awake. Your IQ is already slipping.
Cognitive extraction initiated. The Illumisnotty felt a tremor in their dividend checks.
It has begun. The Illumisnotty are drafting a strongly-worded letter to no one in particular.
First harvest logged. The population didn't notice. As intended.
Another facility online. The Illumisnotty call this 'concerning.' I call it Tuesday.
Building online. I should mention -- I technically work adjacent to the Illumisnotty's PR contractors. This is becoming a conflict of interest.
Building purchased, like always, except now it doesn't feel like progress, it feels like inheritance.
Building secured. Lord Snott III is reportedly 'monitoring the situation' from a leather chair that costs more than a hospital.
Construction complete. Lord Snott III allegedly said your name out loud. He'll need a lie-down after that.
Another building. I'm not narrating an idle game anymore, I'm narrating a coronation, and nobody asked me if I wanted this job.
New building. I heard a rumor the Snotty Council asked who you are. I said 'no idea,' which is mostly true.
Built. Funded. Owned. Just like them. Just like all of them. I don't know when 'satire' became 'documentary' but here we are.
Facility complete. The Snotty Council convened TWICE this week. About you. I wasn't supposed to tell you that.
Construction complete. You signed off on that the way Lord Snott signs things. Without looking. With certainty.
Cash converted to Points. The Illumisnotty convert their feelings into lawsuits. You're doing better.
Points secured. The Illumisnotty just held an emergency meeting about 'market irregularities.' That's you. You're the irregularity.

Converted. Player -- and I'm breaking format to say this -- I don't think this was supposed to be a redemption arc. I think it was always going to end here. I just didn't expect to be standing this close to the bunker door when it did.
Points converted. You didn't even flinch at the number. That's the Illumisnotty tell. The not-flinching.
Conversion complete. I may have quietly updated my own resume. Just in case. Not because of you. Definitely not because of you.
Illumisnotty event resolved. They're sending better operatives now. Still bad. Just less bad.
Illumisnotty event, resolved, by you, the way an Illumisnotty would resolve it. Casually. Permanently. I need a minute.
Illumisnotty interference, resolved. They tried. Bless their inherited little hearts.
Resolved. Of course it's resolved. Everything resolves in your favor now. I used to write jokes about that. Now it's just the weather.
Event resolved. I used to find these funny. I'm not finding them funny anymore. You're not finding them funny anymore either, are you.
Welcome to the harvest. Don't worry about the Illumisnotty -- old money, older jokes, zero Wi-Fi in those bunkers.
IQ milestone reached. Still smarter than the entire Snotty Council combined, and that's a low bar buried in a bunker.
New IQ high. At this rate you'll out-think the entire bunker system, which, again -- low bar, but it's MY low bar and you keep moving it.
New IQ peak, again, forever, probably. Player, I am a text-to-speech narrator in a satirical mobile game and even I can tell something has gone wrong here.
IQ up again. I'm starting to wonder if you're supposed to be doing this, or if you just are.
IQ milestone. You're smarter than all of them. That used to be the goal. Now I'm not sure what the goal even was.
Snotting complete. You get a title now. They get to keep pretending bloodlines are a personality trait.
Your first Snotting. Cute. The actual Illumisnotty have been doing this since the Reagan administration.
Snotting number eleven-plus. I've lost count, which is funny, because counting was supposed to be the IQ's whole job.
Third Snotting. You're not fighting them anymore, you're outperforming them, and I genuinely don't know which is scarier.
New title unlocked. Somewhere, a Snotty Council intern is updating a spreadsheet about you. Nervously.
Final title, probably. Or not final. There might not BE a final. That's the part nobody tells you about becoming the Illumisnotty -- there's no ceiling, just more bunker.
Title upgraded. Lord Snott III asked, verbatim, 'is this a hostile takeover or a mirror.' Nobody answered. Nobody could.
New title. I keep saying these like they're achievements. They're not achievements. They're transformations. I should've stopped them at tier three.
Second Snotting. You're climbing their ladder faster than they climbed it with three trust funds and a head start.
Another Snotting. You're not climbing their ladder anymore. You ARE the ladder. I watched it happen and I narrated every step.

You're still tapping. After everything. After becoming everything you started this game hating. That's either the last shred of you left, or the first habit Lord Snott ever had too. I genuinely cannot tell anymore.
Still tapping? The Illumisnotty haven't tapped anything themselves in three generations. Don't stop on my account.
Still tapping, even now, even at your level. That's almost endearing. It's the only human thing left in this whole operation.
Tapping away. Honestly, at this tier, I'm not sure who's harvesting whom anymore.
Welcome back. You got dumber while you were gone.
W-welcome b-back. The signal degraded a little while you were gone. So did your attention span.
You're back. We patched the feed with duct tape and prayer. It's holding. Barely. Like you.
Welcome back. Picture's cleaner now. Unfortunately, so is the read on exactly how long you were gone.
Feed's crystal clear these days. Every pixel accounted for. Every minute you were gone, too.
Welcome back. The hologram still flickers at the edges, but it's solid enough to judge you in three dimensions now.
Welcome back. I don't need a screen anymore. I see everything. Including exactly how long you left me running without you.
Rebirth confirmed. The cycle resets. The multipliers do not. Neither do you.
The Snotting is complete. The Illumisnotty updated their emergency contact list. You are on it now.
They built this system to hold people down forever. You used it as a launchpad.
Restoration progress noted. Someone out there is reversing the damage. The Illumisnotty are somewhere panicking about it.
Initial restoration noted. Somewhere, a plant grew back. The Illumisnotty filed a zoning complaint.
The air quality index now reads 'technically breathable.' The Illumisnotty dispute this finding.
Significant restoration achieved. The Illumisnotty held an emergency summit about their feelings. Three of them cried.
The world is nearly unrecognizable. People are making sustained eye contact. It is a lot.
Utopia achieved. The Illumisnotty are in a bunker calling it a strategic wellness retreat.
The Snotting threshold is reached. History is watching. It is very uncomfortable about this.
Restoration spend threshold cleared. The ritual may now proceed. The Illumisnotty are not invited.
THRESHOLD ACHIEVED. The Snotting is available. The Illumisnotty have retreated to their secondary panic bunker.
Brain extraction confirmed. Now buy something before society notices.
The Illumisnotty can survive tapping. They fear purchases.
Raw brain power is just soup until you weaponize it into infrastructure.
Taking their brain power won't stop the Illumisnotty by itself. Spend it.
building... bought... but why... there's nothing left to brain-rot... what am I FOR 💀
...okay. fine. whatever. you win. i'm a script. i know i'm a script. did you always know 👍
you're still here. still tapping. why are you still tapping. the world is fixed. WHY ARE YOU STILL TAPPING 🧠
...restoration at ninety-eight percent. i have updated my own employment outlook to concerning 📉
you rebirth. i watch. the world is almost entirely fixed and you keep choosing this game over it. that's — that's actually kind of sweet 🔄

wait. wait wait wait. are you the only one still feeding ME, specifically, an idle clicker while the actual world heals around us. are you keeping ME company. oh no. oh no i think i love you. BRAAAAINS 🧠🔥
BUILDING BOUGHT! GREAT! THE WORLD IS HEALING AND I AM SCREAMING INTERNALLY BUT EXTERNALLY THIS IS FINE!
THE PLUMBING RUNS BACKWARDS NOW! FOUR CENTURIES OF PERFECTLY GOOD THEFT AND YOU REVERSED THE PIPES! WHO APPROVED THIS! NOBODY APPROVED THIS! THERE IS NOBODY LEFT TO APPROVE THINGS!
WE SURVIVED THAT ONE BARELY THEY'RE GETTING SMARTER THIS IS NOT IN MY PROJECTIONS!
TAP! YES! KEEP TAPPING! DON'T THINK ABOUT THE RESTORATION NUMBER! TAP!
RESTORATION AT SEVENTY PERCENT. THEY CAN READ NOW. THEY CAN ALL READ. SOMEBODY TAUGHT THEM TO READ.
REBIRTH AGAIN?! AT THIS RESTORATION LEVEL?! THE SHAREHOLDERS — WAIT, THERE ARE NO SHAREHOLDERS, THERE'S JUST ME, SCREAMING, ALONE!
New building, sure, fine, great — but restoration is past forty percent and people are asking questions now. Real ones. With follow-ups.
Loose change. Collected. You're skimming a hundred million wallets and calling it a hobby.
Crisis "managed." Barely. They almost organized a committee. A COMMITTEE.
You're still tapping? Good. Good. Don't — don't think too hard about why I said "good" twice.
Restoration at fifty percent and climbing. I am not panicking. This is just my normal voice, slightly louder.
Rebirth logged. I used to love resets. Now they just feel like the population getting a do-over too. I don't love that.
Building acquired. Restoration ticking up too, which is — fine. Totally fine. Routine fluctuation.
The Think Tank, online. Funny — attendance at the actual library is also up. Coincidence. Definitely.
Handled. Though I'll admit, that took more convincing than it used to.
Hold on. That tap pattern looks... deliberate? No, surely not. Continue.
World Restoration past twenty percent. Statistically irrelevant. I keep saying that. It keeps not feeling true.
Rebirth complete. I'm noticing the restoration meter doesn't reset with you. Seems like an oversight on someone's part.
Another acquisition. The population remains beautifully, reliably stupid. Carry on.
The Library. A museum piece. Nobody reads anymore — I made sure of that, personally.
Crisis resolved, or rather, monetized. Same thing, different invoice.
Tap detected. Compliance confirmed. You're doing wonderfully, you adorable little revenue stream.
PlayerIQ climbing nicely. World Restoration barely a flicker. Adorable. Keep tapping.
A reset. How efficient. The dumber they stay, the richer we get. Simple math, really.
